text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's dedicated run left the 
spectators in sheer awe.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Man, that was amazing! Did you see 
that!? Bourbon, way to go!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It was amazing, but if the distance gets 
longer, maybe she won't be able to run 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No! In my mind's eye, I could clearly see 
her maintaining that sheer speed over 
2,000 meters!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"She is undeniably a top contender for 
next year's Classic Class...! She has what 
it takes to aim for the Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon is amazing...!

At any rate, it became a race where many 
people came to acknowledge Mihono 
Bourbon's dream.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have returned, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However, whether 
'convincing the public' has been 
accomplished remains uncertain.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"No words such as 'You've convinced me' 
were given to me."
choice_data_list: They were fully convinced, you know.

text_block_list.text:
At the very least, the spectators around 
us were amazed by Mihono Bourbon's running 
and acknowledged it. When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status: 『Shock』... So there was an 
element of 『Conviction』 accompanying 
that murmur.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, this order is deemed 
complete. Please proceed with your next 
order.

Starting next year is finally the Classic 
tier. Which means—

"The Spring Stakes would make a perfect 
touchstone for the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Referencing data. The 
distance of the Spring Stakes is 1,800 
meters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I estimate that further 
stamina reinforcement is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I request permission to train 
after returning home today.

I gave a firm nod to her enthusiastic 
offer.

On my way home. As I was waiting for 
Mihono Bourbon at the entrance—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon was incredible... No one was 
badmouthing her anymore.

An Umamusume came out of the Hanshin 
Racecourse.

(Rice Shower—a gentle, reserved Umamusume 
of the same generation as Mihono Bourbon.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...No getting discouraged... Rice made up 
her mind. She promised she'd do her 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna try super, super hard in the 
Twinkle Series and change...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a Rice Shower... who can 
make everyone smile...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice Shower-san?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaa!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Did you just call my name? Do you need 
something?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-B-Bourbon-san……!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, uh, um... well...! It's not that I 
needed something... but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Today's race was incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I am deeply humbled.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, uh, and, well...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-Then, see you later...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...? I wonder why they were in such a 
rush...?

At any rate, the Asahi Hai FS concluded 
without a hitch—

And so began the days of working hard 
toward our next target race, the Spring 
Stakes!
